{{Quote|An investigation into the above referenced case file, re: the wanted felon going by the street name "Vistis," revealed evidence to indicate the subject was legally terminated by a member of the Jedi Order pursuing official Republic business, specifically the search for stolen top secret military research files.|The Investigatory Panel to a Jedi Knight on the death of Vistis Garn|<ref name="Case File #1142-235-3721" />}}
The '''Coruscant Security Special Investigation Panel''' was a panel of officials in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], which operated on<ref name="Case File #1142-235-3721" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They investigated incidents where [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement personnel]], including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], used [[Death/Legends|deadly]] force and they would then decide if it had been legal to use such force or not. If the person was a criminal with a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] and was terminated legally, the Special Investigation Panel would award the person who had terminated the criminal with the promised bounty.<ref name="Case File #1142-235-3721" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security Special Investigation Panel was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Case File #1142-235-3721" /> During the mission "Stolen Secrets," the player can choose to terminate [[Vistis Garn]] for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points.<ref name="Stolen Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> If the player chooses to do so, the Special Investigation Panel sends the player a message stating they investigated [[Case File 1142-235-3721|Vistis' case file]] and declared the termination to be legal. They then offer the bounty to the player.<ref name="Case File #1142-235-3721" />
